repoPurpose: Planning and documentation repository for a future local-only browser extension that enhances the ChatGPT web UI at https://chatgpt.com/*.

workManagement.delivery: issue/work object -> branch -> verification -> pull request

safetyRules: Treat current source, manifests, configs, tests, workflows, and current documentation as higher-priority truth than planning notes.
Inspect and preserve unrelated dirty/untracked local work before edits.
Do not invent runnable commands, implementation state, tests, deployment, or release results.
Do not merge, deploy, publish, tag, or release without explicit authorization.
Keep Aetheris UI local-only unless the product direction changes explicitly.
Do not add telemetry, analytics, cloud sync, remote code, automatic message sending, or account/session manipulation.
sensitivePathRules: Do not commit browser profile data, generated dependency/build output, temporary/backup artifacts, private prompts, private workflow notes, credentials, keys, tokens, private URLs, or secrets.
knownRisks: The repository has no runnable application scaffold yet.
Research recommendations may become stale and must be re-verified before implementation.
No dedicated private security-reporting contact is declared.
ChatGPT DOM integration is expected to be fragile once source work begins.
Browser extension policy requirements can change.
